deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for service=model-serving (production)
Environment: prod-canary
Release: tag=v1.24.0-canary commit=3f7a2b6
Initial traffic: 2% across us-west1 and eu-central-1
Pipeline: rolling canary with health checks, prefix cache warmup, and smoke tests
Build: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/12345 :rocket:

maria: ack — I'll watch smoke checks and synthetic traces :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary progressed -> 5% (us-west1 only). No 5xx in the last 5m, avg latency +18ms (expected during kv warm).

ajay: saw a small 502 spike on model-backend-1 at 11:07 (2 occurrences). Retries recovered. Putting the host on reduced weight.

sophie: looks like kv-cache misses during cold starts; latency spike correlates with eviction churn. Recommend holding at 5% for +10m to let caches warm.

maria: agree. holding at 5% and monitoring error budget. Running a quick eval set against canary (prompt subset v2).

deploy-bot: Hold confirmed. Auto-progress paused by policy (min-success-window=10m). Health: passing (smoke=ok, errors=minor transient).

(10m later)

deploy-bot: Canary advanced -> 20% (us-west1 + eu-central-1). No sustained errors; synthetic eval: pass (0 regressions).

jordan: ran cross-region p95 checks, looks stable. No notable regressions on sample prompts. :+1:

ajay: also validated fallback routes — routing policy behaved as expected on one simulated node loss.

deploy-bot: Promotion decision: approved by on-call and QA. Promoting to 100% traffic and pinning release.
Action: pin tag=v1.24.0-canary -> stable=v1.24.0 at commit=3f7a2b6
Rolling traffic shift in progress...

maria: thanks — monitoring dashboards and alerts set for the next 30m. Will escalate if anything >1% error rate.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete — traffic 100% on v1.24.0. Version pinned. Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/1.24.0
If issues occur, rollback playbook: run `deploy rollback --tag previous-stable` or open incident channel #incidents. :white_check_mark:

jordan: merging release notes and tagging release on the repo. Noting the kv-cache tuning tweak for follow-up perf ticket.

sophie: created a follow-up PR for cache tuning and a canary metric to surface early cache-warm latency spikes.

deploy-bot: Thread closed — end of deploy sequence.
